method: 3x3 2D rigid-load-plate on signed independent normal anchor springs; ideal tangential shear distribution

direct8.label: P40 baseline: eight flange points
direct8.type: legacy interface not independent cabinet support

carrier4.label: A: wide carrier with four remote pads

rails4.label: B: two depthwise rails with four top/bottom stations

inputs.warning: Reduced-order rigid plate with signed springs, not validated FEM, shell/bolt bearing, contact, joint stress or test.

warnings: All k springs are hypothetical and cannot be used to infer safety or compliance of MDF without measurements.
Support anchors represent assumed load paths; connection from actual eight flange bolts into a carrier/rail is not modeled.
Compression and uplift require unilateral contact; this signed bilateral model cannot predict actual clamping force.
3D cabin, basket terminals, connector and tools collision NOT checked, only 2D flange and panel margins.
Direct8 is a legacy mathematical comparator, NOT equivalent to eight real independent structural supports.
Fastener ultimate strength, MDF peel/splitting, fatigue, shock timescale and acoustics remain unknown.
